product.olivetti-philos-44.summary: The business Philos with a monochrome display and disk access under the keyboard.
product.olivetti-philos-44.history: Olivetti placed the 44 at the top of the Philos line in December 1993. Access advertised the monochrome version at C$2,649 in February 1994.
product.olivetti-philos-44.architecture: The hinged keyboard made the removable disk accessible. BYTE tested a 25 MHz 486SL, and Access advertised a 486 SL-33 (DX) for the 44 line.
product.olivetti-philos-44.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-philos-44.limitations: Firmware comparison and boot tests are pending.
product.olivetti-philos-44.ad: Olivetti advertisement, BYTE, December 1993, PDF p. 229.
product.olivetti-philos-44.byte: BYTE/NSTL Lab Report, March 1994, 46 Powerful Portables Tested.
product.olivetti-philos-44.dealer: Access Business Centre, The Computer Paper, February 1994.
